basis: Skeletal dysplasia, microcephaly and dental defects define disease; insulin resistance occurs in ~40-70%. Hearing loss 30-79% omitted by cap.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: abnormal dentition is defining; tooth agenesis occurs in 80-99%.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: insulin resistance affects ~40-70%, especially with increasing age; retained as a systemic manifestation under the primary cap.

basis: Intellectual disability, seizures and cerebellar atrophy; pes planus 2/2 and maxillary hypoplasia 3/5 do not establish functional skeletal damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: frequent skeletal morphology alone, including pes planus 2/2 and maxillary hypoplasia 3/5, does not establish damaging locomotor involvement.

basis: Marrow failure and the classic mucocutaneous triad define dyskeratosis congenita; pulmonary fibrosis is not established at >=30% for this subtype.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: oral leukoplakia belongs to the classic diagnostic triad; oral mucosa maps to gastrointestinal.

basis: NCF4-related phagocyte dysfunction; characteristic inflammatory colitis/fistula and perioral eczema each occur in 1/1 annotated patient; frequency evidence is limited.

decisions.haematologic: primary: inherited defective phagocyte bactericidal function is a functional blood-cell disorder, alongside immunodeficiency.

basis: Progressive cerebral arterial stenosis defines moyamoya; stroke can exceed 30% but is separately diagnosed. Transient ischemic symptoms alone do not establish lasting brain damage.

decisions.neurologic: none: stroke is a separately diagnosed complication, even when common; this record does not establish common intrinsic brain damage independent of stroke.

basis: Cerebral arteriopathy, leukoencephalopathy and premature alopecia define CARASIL; alopecia 5/6. Intrinsic spondylosis and localized osteoporosis occur in 30-79%.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: premature scalp alopecia is a defining clinical hallmark explicitly included in the definition, supported by 5/6 patients.

basis: Leiner disease is defined by exfoliative dermatitis, immune dysfunction and persistent diarrhea with failure to thrive; supplied phenotypes occur in 80-99%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: persistent diarrheal intestinal dysfunction with failure to thrive is a defining component, supported by diarrhea in 80-99%.

basis: ADA deficiency causes SCID and lymphopenia; intrinsic neurologic impairment occurs in ~30-50% (motor delay 1/1). Skin inflammation 1/1 omitted by cap; infections are separate.

decisions.neurologic: involved: intrinsic metabolic neurodevelopmental impairment occurs in roughly 30-50%; motor delay 1/1 supports this, independently of infectious complications.

basis: An inborn organelle-fission disorder; encephalopathy and developmental impairment characterize most described patients and the listed subtype.

decisions.neurologic: involved: encephalopathy affects most described cases, but the umbrella concept itself is defined by defective organelle fission rather than brain disease.

basis: Cerebral microangiopathy and leukoencephalopathy define CARASAL; hearing loss in 1/1 annotated patient does not establish involvement in >=30% across the disease.

decisions.otologic: none: sensorineural hearing loss is documented in one annotated patient; its frequency across patients is insufficiently established at >=30%.
